  (20b + c) - (16b + c) = -747 - (-458) \implies 4b = -289 \implies b = \frac{-289}{4}
  \]
- Substitute \( b = \frac{-289}{4} \) back into equation (1):
  \[
  16 \left( \frac{-289}{4} \right) + c = -458 \implies -1156 + c = -458 \implies c = 698

\[
P(0) + Q(0) = 698 + (-582) = 116

\boxed{116}
